thread:
nina: Heads-up: Go SDK sampleapp failed onboarding tests in CI. PATCH to /routes returns 400 from SDK but curl works.

tarek: can you paste payload? which go client version?

nina: client v0.6.3. call: 
```go
client.Routes.Update("r_abc", map[string]interface{}{
  "name": "hi",
  "trafficPercentage": 20,
  "enableRerank": true,
})
```
error: 400 unknown parameter: trafficPercentage

curl uses snake_case and works: traffic_percentage. therapist?

juan: ah param-casing drift. REST uses snake_case fields but our Go SDK marshals struct fields to camelCase unless tags provided. We never added json tags for some route fields.

nina: that explains it. Also noticed the SDK retries on 429 with exponential backoff and replays non-idempotent PATCH without idempotency-key -> duplicates seen in Dedicated tests. curl doesn't auto-retry.

tarek: immediate fixes: 1) add json tags for snake_case on route structs, 2) add automatic Idempotency-Key header for mutating endpoints, 3) ensure retry only on idempotent-safe responses or with key.

juan: i'll push a tiny PR to add tags and adjust the marshaller to preserve unknown keys in a map[string]any for passthrough.

release-bot: Created RDW-1322 (go-sdk: field tags + safe retry) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1322

nina: please add an e2e in sampleapp CI that sends mixed-case fields and asserts server observed snake_case. Also update the quickstart note about SDK casing behavior until patch ships.

tarek: good call. i'll own the idempotency header change and a minor release 0.6.4.

juan: PR open, tests added. thanks for catching this early.
